name: Founding Team Design & Leadership Architecture
description: Deterministic strategic framework to design co-founder domain coverage, structure executive decision rights (RACI/RAPID), model founder reverse vesting and acceleration terms, and build scalable leadership architectures.
frameworks: 4-Domain Co-Founder Coverage Model (CEO/Strategy, CTO/Tech, CPO/Product, CRO/GTM)
Standard 4-Year Reverse Vesting / 1-Year Cliff with Double-Trigger Acceleration Model
logic: The founding team and leadership architecture form the bedrock of an enterprise. Overlapping co-founder domains, unvested founder equity, ambiguous decision rights, or missing leadership capabilities lead to co-founder split-ups, cap table deadlocks, and organizational failure. Execute mathematically sound founding team design.
chainsOfThought: Step 1: Audit Founding Team Architecture -> Map Co-Founder Roles across Strategy (CEO), Technology (CTO), Product (CPO) & GTM (CRO) -> Identify Domain Overlaps & Gaps
Step 2: Decision Rights Standardization -> Structure RACI/RAPID Matrix for High-Stakes Decisions (Hiring, Budgeting, Product Roadmap, Fundraising)
Step 3: Founder Equity & Reverse Vesting Modeling -> Model 4-Year Vesting with 1-Year Cliff, Single vs Double-Trigger Acceleration Clauses & Buyout Terms (integrated with ocs_01 & ldl_01)
Step 4: Leadership Capacity & TCO Synthesis -> Model Founder Draws + Executive Hires (VP Eng, VP Sales) + Board/Advisor Equity Reserves (integrated with swd_01 & cmp_01)
Step 5: Executive Sign-Off & Founder Approval -> Broadcast WebSocket Approval Request via ExecApprovalManager for Founding Agreements & Leadership Structure
Step 6: Export Leadership Package -> Generate Founding Blueprint JSON, RACI Matrix CSV, Vesting Dashboard HTML & Manifest -> Archive in Vault
Step 7: Continuous Governance & Alignment Monitoring -> Register Alert Triggers in PCL Daemon -> Flag Co-Founder Friction or Unfilled Leadership Gaps
bestPractices: Always subject founder equity to 4-year reverse vesting with a 1-year cliff to protect company capitalization table integrity.
Enforce clear decision rights (RACI/RAPID) for key operational areas to prevent co-founder gridlock.
Require explicit human founder sign-off before modifying founding equity splits or executive governance agreements.
